Halloween Printables

Halloween Countdown Calendar Printable

ByCristina Morero
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:08
Instaread

Looking for a fun Halloween countdown to make the spooky season even more exciting? You’ll love this free Halloween countdown printable!

This cute (and just a little creepy!) Halloween calendar printable lets you count down the days from October 1st all the way to Halloween night.

It features bold spooky lettering, hanging spiders, and a big orange circle highlighting October 31st — the big day!

My Latest Videos

Up next in 15s

Advertisement

It’s perfect for kids and families who love marking off the days until trick-or-treating, but it’s also fun for adults who simply want to enjoy the Halloween spirit all month long.

You can cross off, color in, or sticker each day as Halloween gets closer.

This post may contain affiliate links, which means I’ll receive a commission if you purchase through my links, at no extra cost to you. Please read full disclosure for more information.

Free Printable Halloween Countdown Calendar

Download and print the Halloween countdown calendar — available with both Sunday and Monday start weeks.

DOWNLOAD: Halloween Countdown Printable (Both Sunday & Monday start calendars)

How to use this Halloween countdown

  • Print it on US Letter size paper (or scale to A4) – free for personal and classroom use only.
  • Hang it on your fridge, pinboard, or in your planner
  • Use markers or cute Halloween stickers to mark each day
  • Watch the excitement grow as October 31st approaches!
  • RELATED: Halloween Countdown – How Many Days Until Halloween?
  • RELATED: When is Halloween?

Whether you call it a Halloween countdown calendar, an October countdown, or just a fun Halloween activity for kids, this printable will add a festive touch to your fall days.

Ready to start counting down? Happy haunting — and happy planning!
